## Hermes
- Loads from a plugin directory carrying `plugin.yaml` + `__init__.py`. Two verified paths (hermes_cli/plugins.py): local dev — copy this directory to `~/.hermes/plugins/brand-design/` (user plugin) or `./.hermes/plugins/brand-design/` with `HERMES_ENABLE_PROJECT_PLUGINS=1` (project plugin, opt-in) — then `hermes plugins list` should show it; from a Git host — `hermes plugins install owner/repo`, then `hermes plugins enable brand-design` (or pass `--enable` to `install`) to activate it — install alone does not enable a plugin. Hermes has no marketplace file, so there is no registry listing step beyond the two paths above.
- Plugin skills are NOT surfaced in `<available_skills>` (hermes_cli/plugins.py:3334-3337) — they resolve only as an explicit `<plugin>:<skill>` load. Verify with a load, e.g. `load brand-design:brand-advertising-facts`, never with "list your skills".
- MCP `[needs-substitution]`: `brand-corpus.args[0]`, `brand-corpus.env.BRAND_CORPUS_DIR` use Claude-runtime tokens that Hermes cannot resolve — replace each with a literal value before merging `hermes-mcp.yaml` into your config.
- MCP: `hermes-mcp.yaml` generated from `.mcp.json` — first check whether `~/.hermes/config.yaml` already has a top-level `mcp_servers:` key; if it does NOT, `cat hermes-mcp.yaml >> ~/.hermes/config.yaml` is safe; if it DOES, merge the two `mcp_servers:` blocks by hand instead — a blind append onto an existing `mcp_servers:` key produces a duplicate top-level YAML key, and most parsers silently keep only the last one, dropping your existing servers with no error.
- Dropped — agents: `brand-judge`, `brand-writer`, `council-chair-agent`, `creative-convener`, `design-convener`, `muse-agent`, `strategy-convener`, `voice-convener`; hooks: none.
- Command-only skills now model-routable: none (R-5, #888: `ctx.register_command` carries no invocation-source metadata on Hermes — the plain-skill degradation is the CORRECT terminal fallback here, not a temporary gap).
- Fork skills (their `context` field drops; body runs inline): none.

## Pi
- Loads via `package.json`'s `"pi"` key (`"skills": ["./skills"]`); install with `pi install <path-to-brand-design> -l` from a checkout — confirm with `pi list`, which shows the install path under `Project packages:`. The `"pi-package"` keyword is added automatically (no extra step); once this package is published, that keyword is what the pi.dev gallery scrapes to list it — there is no separate marketplace file to maintain.
- Dropped — agents: `brand-judge`, `brand-writer`, `council-chair-agent`, `creative-convener`, `design-convener`, `muse-agent`, `strategy-convener`, `voice-convener`; hooks: none.

Nothing is generated for Pi — the file already sits at the plugin root, where a `pi install` places it.
